contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine: VRBS ROMA. c.AD330-331, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend - . Reverse shows Wolf and twins. Mint is Trier. See RIC VII, p.214, c.f.522. Obverse shows Helmeted bust left. Obverse legend reads VRBS ROMA. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //(TRS). Condition is fine, die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 1.5g, diameter is 18mm
